name: Contour
description: Contour lines crossing the sheet in parallel, bending where the ground rises.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(@pick(0deg, 22deg, 45deg, 68deg, 90deg), #000 0 5%, transparent 5% 15%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(@pick(0deg, 22deg, 45deg, 68deg, 90deg), #000 0 5%, transparent 5% 15%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
